svg.aria-label: About. I am a third-year Mechatronics Engineering & Society student driven by curiosity and a passion for problem-solving. My journey toward engineering began with a simple habit: breaking things to understand how they worked. From dismantling toys to stationery to accidentally breaking my family’s TV (true story!), I was always determined to destroy and rebuild to learn, and I wouldn't stop until I had (mostly) rebuilt the object I had taken apart. When I finally fixed my first pen as a kid, I realized my love for engineering; a passion that turns chaos into creation. Today and into the future, I wield the same curiosity, wonder and determination in every challenge I face, striving to learn, design and solve with purpose and creativity. School: McMaster University. Program: Mechatronics Engineering & Society. Level: III. Looking for: Co-op, May / Sept 2027. Focus: Integration · Organization · Teaching.
